title: Ophthalmic Mastery: High-Yield FRCS/FRCO Clinical Review
summary: The ultimate high-fidelity review for FRCS/FRCO candidates, synthesizing Kanski and BCSC principles into actionable clinical pearls. This guide covers essential classifications, landmark trials, and diagnostic criteria required for postgraduate success.

sections.title: Key Clinical Pearls
content: The most common cause of a spontaneous vitreous hemorrhage in a non-diabetic is a posterior vitreous detachment (PVD) with a retinal tear.
Shafer's Sign (Tobacco Dust) indicates RPE cells in the vitreous - 90% risk of a retinal break.
Argyll Robertson Pupil: Small, irregular, accommodates but doesn't react (Neurosyphilis - Midbrain lesion).
Fuchs Heterochromic Iridocyclitis: Chronic low-grade uveitis, no posterior synechiae, diffuse fine KPs, risk of cataract/glaucoma.
Pseudoexfoliation Syndrome (PXF): Associated with LOXL1 gene; risk of zonular dehiscence during phacoemulsification.

branches: Presence of 1 = Severe; Presence of 2 = Very Severe

sections.title: Pediatric Cataract: Timing and Critical Periods
content: Congenital Unilateral: Surgery within 4-6 weeks to prevent amblyopia.
Post-op: Aggressive aphakic contact lens fitting or primary IOL (if >6-12 months old).
Risk: High incidence of secondary glaucoma (30%) in aphakic infants.

rows: Grade I + Focal constriction and AV nicking
Grade II + Cotton wool spots, flame hemorrhages, hard exudates
Grade III + Optic disc swelling (Malignant Hypertension)

sections.title: Recent Advances: Gene Therapy & Biosimilars
sections.content: Voretigene neparvovec (Luxturna) is now the standard for RPE65-mediated inherited retinal dystrophy (LCA). Biosimilars for Ranibizumab (Byooviz) and Aflibercept are entering clinical practice to reduce costs. Port Delivery Systems (PDS) and longer-acting agents like Faricimab (dual VEGF/Ang-2 inhibitor) are reshaping management of nAMD and DME.
